name: 11949 · Manorville, NY
findings: ZIP 11949 (Manorville) has 39 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11949 (Manorville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
